$comment: Negative test corpus. Every entry MUST be rejected. A schema is only as good as the things it refuses, so these are the real proof of FR-021 — without them, 'malformed rules are impossible' is an untested claim. Each fixture applies a JSON Merge Patch (RFC 7386) to `base`, changing exactly one thing, so the rejection is attributable to that one thing. `expect_rejected_by` records which layer must catch it: SCHEMA (structurally expressible) or LINT (needs cross-file knowledge). If a fixture is ever rejected by the wrong layer, the split documented in ADR-0003 has drifted.

base.name: Fixture base rule — otherwise valid
base.description: Minimal valid rule. Each fixture below breaks exactly one property of it.

source_references.quote: banks and other payment systems operators never ask for details such as password, PIN, OTP, CVV number

explanation.plain: Base fixture explanation for the user, long enough to satisfy minLength.
explanation.technical: Base fixture explanation for the analyst, long enough to satisfy minLength.

fixtures.name: keyword-matcher-single-indicator
fixtures.reason: CONF-002. A rule resting on one indicator is a keyword matcher. Spans one evidence class, so the min_evidence_classes contract is violated even though the schema shape is legal.

fixtures.name: min-evidence-classes-below-two
fixtures.reason: CONF-002. An author cannot opt out of the combination requirement by declaring a lower threshold.

fixtures.name: weak-indicators-only
fixtures.reason: RP p.13 — 'One weak indicator such as urgency should not be enough on its own.' Two weak indicators across two classes is still not enough.

fixtures.name: unsupported-rule-published
fixtures.reason: RESEARCH-004 section 7. A rule with no verified basis must not reach the published rule set, however plausible.

fixtures.name: deferred-rule-published
fixtures.reason: CONF-003. A rule TrustLens cannot observe must not publish, however well evidenced.

fixtures.name: deferred-without-blocked-by
fixtures.reason: CONF-003. Deferring without recording WHY loses the condition that would make the rule live again.

fixtures.name: partial-without-severity-cap
fixtures.reason: RESEARCH-004 section 7. Partially-evidenced rules publish only with a capped severity contribution.

fixtures.name: non-heuristic-without-source
fixtures.reason: FR-025. Every non-heuristic rule carries at least one graded source reference.

fixtures.name: numeric-risk-score
fixtures.reason: CONF-001 and MP section 10. Risk is derived at evaluation time and is never stored on a rule. additionalProperties:false makes the field unrepresentable.

fixtures.name: severity-as-number
fixtures.reason: CONF-001. Severity is an ordinal. A numeric severity manufactures precision the evidence cannot carry.

fixtures.name: severity-hint-promoted-to-operational
fixtures.reason: CONF-001. The research package's 0-100 values are provenance only. operational_use is const false so the quarantine cannot be lifted by editing a rule.

fixtures.name: overstated-source-grade
fixtures.reason: The most dangerous defect this validator catches: a rule claiming its source is verified when the manifest records RETRIEVAL_FAILED. Silently converts an unevidenced rule into an authoritative one.

fixtures.name: unknown-source-id
fixtures.reason: A source reference that resolves to nothing is an unfalsifiable citation.

fixtures.name: dangling-indicator-reference
fixtures.reason: An indicator nothing extracts can never match. The rule would sit in the set looking like coverage while being dead.

fixtures.name: negative-indicator-in-positive-condition
fixtures.reason: Polarity inversion. Requiring a suppressor to fire a rule means a protective signal raises risk — the exact failure CONF-002 exists to prevent.

fixtures.name: positive-indicator-as-suppressor
fixtures.reason: Polarity inversion in the other direction: a scam signal would cancel the finding.

fixtures.name: unknown-taxonomy-reference
fixtures.reason: RESEARCH-002 rule 3: adding a category requires a source and an evidence grade. A rule may not invent one by referencing it.

fixtures.name: brand-in-rule-identifier
fixtures.reason: CONF-005 and DEC-005. Identifiers are neutral; the issuing body is data, not part of the key.

fixtures.name: published-without-approver
fixtures.reason: FR-023. The lifecycle models separation of duties even where ASM-019 means one person performs both roles.

fixtures.name: silent-degradation-on-unsupported-language
fixtures.reason: NFR-009. The system states what it does not support. Silent degradation is not an option an author may select — the field is a const, not an enum.

fixtures.name: missing-explanation
fixtures.reason: FR-046 and MP section 3. A rule that cannot explain itself cannot exist, let alone publish.

fixtures.name: evidence-verdict-upgraded-against-phase-1
fixtures.reason: A rule graded UNSUPPORTED by the Phase 1 evidence matrix cannot re-grade itself as SUPPORTED. Verdicts flow from RESEARCH-004, not from the rule author.

fixtures.name: reduce-effect-without-magnitude
fixtures.reason: A REDUCE suppression cannot validate until DET-001 defines the reduction mathematics. Correct failure: it prevents magnitudes being invented ahead of the model that gives them meaning.

fixtures.name: published-on-failed-source-without-manual-evidence
fixtures.reason: DEC-006 / ADR-0015. A rule may not publish on a source the automated pass graded RETRIEVAL_FAILED unless a manual_retrieval block supplies real evidence. Honest verification_status (RETRIEVAL_FAILED) passes L6, but L11 refuses publication with no publishable-grade evidence behind it.

fixtures.name: official-alternate-claiming-supported
fixtures.reason: DEC-006 / ADR-0015 class cap. Official-channel (OFFICIAL_ALTERNATE) evidence is genuine but a step below a formal advisory; it caps a rule at PARTIAL. A rule claiming SUPPORTED on it alone must be rejected.
